name: lanshare
title: LAN Share
description: Share a directory over HTTP on the LAN with a file index, or host a shared full-page notebook; optional HTTP Basic auth and LAN IP discovery.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: 局域网共享
zh-CN.description: 在局域网通过 HTTP 共享目录（自动索引页）或托管一个共享的全页记事本；可选 Basic 认证，并打印局域网 IP。

tools.name: lanshare serve
tools.description: Share a directory over HTTP with a browsable index; optional Basic auth; add --daemon to run in the background

tools.name: lanshare note
tools.description: Host a shared LAN notebook (one full-page textarea, autosaved to a file); optional Basic auth; --daemon to background

tools.name: lanshare ip
tools.description: Print the host's LAN IPv4 addresses

tools.name: lanshare status
tools.description: Show the background share started with --daemon

tools.name: lanshare stop
tools.description: Stop background server(s): all, or just serve / note
